results.answer:
Block 1 (key takeaway): 
Danone reports emissions-related disclosures in 2025 through its Climate Transition Plan, which includes science-based targets for net-zero emissions by 2050, scope 3 emission reductions, and value chain decarbonization initiatives.

Block 2 (detailed answer): 
In 2025, Danone reports emissions-related disclosures primarily through its Climate Transition Plan published in December 2023, which replaced its 2016 Climate Policy [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 242]. The plan establishes science-based targets aligned with the 1.5°C pathway, aiming to reduce emissions by 2030 and achieve net-zero emissions by 2050 across its entire value chain [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 242]. Key elements include eight programs covering direct operations, milk, ingredients, packaging, logistics, co-manufacturing, supplier engagement, and low-carbon portfolio management [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 242]. The company reports that scope 3 emissions represent 95.2% of total emissions (20,614 million tCO2eq.), with scope 3 related to milk purchases accounting for 31.5% due to methane emissions [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 262]. Danone achieved a 13.3% reduction in methane emissions in 2023 compared to 2020 and reduced total emissions from 27,179 million tCO2eq. in 2019 to 21,659 million tCO2eq. in 2023 [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 262].

Block 3 (Evidence excerpts):
"The Climate Transition Plan, published in December 2023 by Danone, replaced the Climate Policy of 2016... This plan is based on eight programs aimed at 1) reducing Danone's emissions by 2030, in line with its science-based targets and aligned with the 1.5°C pathway and 2) providing forward-looking perspectives for its journey towards Net Zero by 2050" [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 242]

"The largest portion of emissions is generated by scope 3, representing 95.2% of total emissions (i.e. 20,614 million tCOeq.), while scope 1 and 2 cover only 4.8% (i.e.789 ktCOeq. for scope 1 and 256 ktCOeq. for scope 2)" [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 262]

"In 2023, its total emissions across its entire value chain amounted to 21,659 million tCO2eq. (compared with 27,179 million tCO2eq in 2019)" [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 262]

"Scope 3 related to milk purchases is the most significant, representing 31.5% of total emissions, notably due to methane emissions from the supply of fresh milk used in dairy products" [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 262]

"Danone has made it one of its priorities to decarbonize its value chain, achieving a 13.3% reduction in methane emissions in 2023 compared to 2020" [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 262]

Block 1 (key takeaway): Danone discloses comprehensive governance, ethics, and compliance information in its 2025 reporting period, including its Code of Business Conduct, Integrity Policy, whistleblowing system (Danone Ethics Line), anti-corruption measures, and third-party compliance programs. The company emphasizes ethical conduct, transparency, and accountability through multiple internal controls and reporting mechanisms.

Block 2 (detailed answer): Danone's 2025 disclosures show a robust governance framework focused on ethics and compliance. The company maintains a Code of Business Conduct and Integrity Policy, both updated in 2022 and translated into 34 languages [Danone's 2022 Report, p. 195]. These policies cover anti-corruption, conflicts of interest, fraud, money laundering, and interactions with government officials [Danone's 2022 Report, p. 195]. Danone operates a comprehensive whistleblowing system called "Danone Ethics Line" which is available in 52 languages and accessible via internet or phone line [Danone's 2022 Report, p. 196]. The system allows employees and third parties to report violations anonymously and protects whistleblowers from retaliation [Danone's 2022 Report, p. 196]. The company's compliance program includes risk assessments, mitigation plans, training, and due diligence on third parties [Danone's 2022 Report, p. 196]. Additionally, Danone implements a Vigilance Plan that includes Human Rights Due Diligence systems with target of 100% coverage by 2025 [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 248].

• "The Danone Ethics Line provides a secure channel for anyone wishing to report any alleged violation of business conduct principles" [Danone's 2023 Report, p. 271]
